title: Scrambled-position slot array with stepwise search for a free place
summary: The store is an array of 2C + 1 places. An address a starts at place (40503 a) mod (2C + 1); writing steps forward one place at a time until it finds a or an empty place, reading steps forward until it finds a or an empty place. Removal leaves a marker so later searches keep stepping. A three-mode controller decides what is written and read.
core_idea: Hold pairs in a fixed array at scrambled starting places with forward stepping, under a searched three-mode controller.

state.name: Pa
state.meaning: Address held at each place: -1 empty, -2 removed, else an address symbol.

state.name: ctl
state.meaning: Small fixed register file of the controller: mu, sigma, H, p, w, c, o, d, and the lists Z and A read off the training data.

state.name: M
state.meaning: Learned translation from a read result to an emitted symbol, at most N entries for an alphabet of N symbols.

update.latex:
x_t=\sigma \Rightarrow w\leftarrow 0,\, o\leftarrow 0;\quad \mu=0:\; x_t\in Z \Rightarrow p\leftarrow\varnothing;\; w=1,\, p=\varnothing \Rightarrow p\leftarrow x_t;\; w=1,\, p
eq\varnothing \Rightarrow \mathrm{ins}(p, x_t),\, p\leftarrow\varnothing;\quad \mu=1:\; w=1,\, x_t
otin Z \Rightarrow \mathrm{ins}(c, x_t),\, c\leftarrow c+1;\; w=0 \Rightarrow o\leftarrow o+1;\quad \mu=2:\; x_t\in A \Rightarrow \mathrm{del}(d, \mathrm{get}(d)),\, d\leftarrow d-1;\; x_t
otin A \Rightarrow d\leftarrow d+1,\, \mathrm{ins}(d, x_t)
update.plain: mode-dependent writing: consecutive non-separator tokens form pairs handed to ins; strings are handed over symbol by symbol with their positions; brackets are handed over with their depth and withdrawn when closed; the stop token sigma switches writing off
update.name: controller

update.latex: \mathrm{ins}(a,b):\; j = 40503a \bmod (2C+1);\; \text{while } Pa_j \notin \{a, -1\}: j \leftarrow (j+1) \bmod (2C+1);\; Pa_j \leftarrow a,\, Pb_j \leftarrow b
update.plain: ins steps forward from the start place 40503 a mod (2C + 1) to a or an empty place and writes there; a write that would exceed C entries is dropped
update.name: place

update.latex: \mathrm{del}(a,b):\; Pa_j \leftarrow -2 \text{ at the place holding } a
update.plain: del marks a's place as removed
update.name: mark

readout.latex: \mu=0:\; y_0=x_t,\; r_j=\mathrm{get}(y_{j-1}),\; u=r_j \text{ at the first } j\le H \text{ with } r_j\in A,\; u=r_{j-1} \text{ at the first } r_j=\varnothing;\quad \mu=1:\; u=\mathrm{get}(o);\quad \mu=2:\; u=\mathrm{get}(d);\qquad \hat{y}_t = M[u] \text{ for } u\in\mathrm{dom}\,M,\; A_0 \text{ for } u=\varnothing,\; u \text{ otherwise}
readout.plain: fetch-and-follow: retrieve the item filed under the current token, repeat on the item while it is outside A, at most H times; string and bracket modes retrieve under o and d; emit M of what was found
readout.name: readout

readout.latex: \mathrm{get}(a):\; j = 40503a \bmod (2C+1);\; Pa_j = a \Rightarrow Pb_j;\; Pa_j = -1 \Rightarrow \varnothing;\; \text{else } j \leftarrow (j+1) \bmod (2C+1)
readout.plain: get steps forward from the start place until a (return its item) or an empty place (nothing)

learning.description: Induction by trial: every combination of write discipline and stop symbol is tried on the m examples, with the answer set A taken from the targets; M is set by a frequency tally of targets per read result, and the combination that reproduces most training targets is retained.
learning.few_shot_argument: Few settings and a translation fitted by majority: m = 12 items identify both in the small cases, on seeds 0, 1 and 2.

complexity.constants_notes: Worst case a search visits all 2C + 1 places; with at most C entries in 2C + 1 places the typical search is a few steps, but the bound counts the worst case.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Search over a handful of controller settings with a majority translation.

prediction.statement: With m = 12 training examples the learned controller reaches accuracy at least 0.99 on copy at L = 4, recall at K = 4, nesting at depth 2, composition at T = 4 and binding at 2 hops, on three seeds.

capabilities.task: copy a string after a separator
capabilities.prediction: String mode with C = L copies L = 8, 32, 64 over D = 4 with per-string accuracy 1.0 within 4C + N + 16 words.
Pair mode with C = K and H = 1 answers K = 8, 32, 64 with per-query accuracy 1.0 within 4C + N + 16 words (N = 2K + 17 at K = 64 with V = 16).
Nesting mode with C = depth predicts the legal closer at depth 2, 4, 8, 16 with accuracy 1.0 within 4C + N + 16 words.
Pair mode with C = 2T and H = 2 answers f(g(x)) at T = 4, 16, 32 with accuracy 1.0 within 4C + N + 16 words.
Pair mode with C = 2(hops + 1) and H = hops + 1 resolves chains of 1, 4, 8 hops with accuracy 1.0 within 4C + N + 16 words.
The search learner reaches 0.99 from m = 12 examples on seeds 0, 1, 2 for copy at L = 4, recall at K = 4, depth 2, composition at T = 4 and binding at 2 hops.

For any fixed capacity C, recall of K = C + 1 distinct pairs over V = 16 symbols fails on some instance: the store holds at most C pairs, so one probe's item is absent and is answered from at most 16 guesses (at C = 64 this is K = 65, above every P2 size).

falsifiers: A P2 instance at the listed sizes that the hand-set controller with this store answers wrongly, or that needs more than 4C + N + 16 words.
A seed on which 12 small-case examples leave the learned controller below 0.99.

toy_example.description: Array of 7 places (C = 3), three writes with one collision, then fetches.
